blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Egocentric human data provides a scalable source of experience for robot learning, but varies substantially in human-robot alignment, behavioral coverage, and available supervision. Existing work shows favorable scaling with increasing human data, but it remains unclear which data properties drive downstream robot gains and how to use such data throughout the training pipeline. We present a systematic study of egocentric human data with different alignment and supervision under a unified world-action model framework. With the model backbone fixed, we disentangle the effects of human-robot alignment, data duration and task diversity, action supervision, and data usage strategies. We find that aligned human demonstrations substantially improve out-of-distribution generalization and reduce target-task robot data requirements; data duration and task diversity affect downstream capabilities differently; and video-only supervision remains effective without action labels, providing a strong foundation for subsequent video-action training. We validate these findings through closed-loop policy evaluation on both real robots and RoboDojo. Rather than treating data duration as the sole scaling axis, Ego4WAM shows how alignment, task diversity, available supervision, and usage strategy jointly shape the value of egocentric human data for robot learning. The project page is available at sunzhihao18.github.io/Ego4WAM .
blocks.zh: 以Egocent为核心的人类数据为机器人学习提供了可扩展的经验来源,但在人-机器人对接,行为覆盖和可用监督方面差异很大. 现有工作显示,随着人类数据的增加,其规模是有利的,但仍不清楚哪些数据属性能推动下游机器人的发展以及如何在整个培训过程中使用这些数据。 我们提出了对以自我为中心的人类数据的系统研究,在一个统一的世界行动模式框架下进行不同的调整和监督。 随着模型主干网的固定,我们解开人与机器人对接,数据持续时间和任务多样性,动作监督,以及数据使用策略的影响. 我们发现,调整后的人类演示大大改进了分配外的通俗化,并减少了目标任务机器人数据要求;数据持续时间和任务多样性对下游能力的影响不同;并且仅限视频监督仍然有效,没有行动标签,为随后的视频行动培训奠定了坚实的基础. 我们通过对真正的机器人和机器人的封闭式政策评价来验证这些结果。 Ego4WAM没有将数据持续时间作为唯一的缩放轴,而是展示了对齐,任务多样性,可用监督和使用策略如何共同塑造了以自我为中心的人类数据对于机器人学习的价值. 项目网页见sunzhihao18.github.io/Ego4WAM。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Egocentric human data offers a scalable source of experience for robot learning, covering a breadth of objects, scenes, and task variations that is difficult to match through robot teleoperation alone ( Grauman et al., 2022 ; Damen et al., 2022 ; Hoque et al., 2026 ) . Such experience can provide different forms of supervision for robot learning. Human hand actions provide action supervision for imitation learning ( Kareer et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025 ) , while World-Action Models (WAMs) ( Li et al., 2026a ) additionally leverage future-state prediction as world-modeling supervision to learn task-relevant dynamics. Recent studies have shown strong human-to-robot transfer and favorable scaling with increasing egocentric data ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Team, 2026 ; DynaRobotics, 2026 ) , yet it remains unclear which data properties drive downstream robot gains and how to use the data throughout the training pipeline. This raises a central question: When scaling egocentric human data for robot learning, which data properties and usage strategies matter most?
blocks.zh: Egoocentre人类数据为机器人学习提供了可扩展的经验来源,覆盖了众多的物体,场景,以及任务变异,通过机器人单独远程操作难以相匹配(Grauman等,2022;Damen等,2022;Hoque等,2026). 这种经验可以为机器人学习提供不同形式的监督. 人手行动为模仿学习提供了行动监督(Kareer等,2025b;Li等,2025),而"世界行动模型"(WAMs)(Li等,2026a)则进一步将未来状态预测作为世界模型监督,以学习与任务相关的动态. 最近的研究显示,随着越来越多的自我中心数据(Intelligence等人,2025年;Zheng等人,2026年;Team,2026年;DynaRobotics,2026年),人对机器人的强力转移和有利缩放,但尚不清楚哪些数据属性驱动下游机器人增益,以及如何在整个培训管道使用这些数据。 这就提出了一个中心问题: 当为机器人学习而缩放以自我为中心的人类数据时,哪些数据属性和使用策略最为重要?

blocks.en: Egocentric data varies along several dimensions that directly affect its utility for robot learning. At one end of the spectrum, human demonstrations can be carefully aligned with robot data in viewpoint, motion speed, and behavior style, facilitating cross-embodiment learning but limiting the diversity of experience that can be collected. Relaxing these alignment constraints allows egocentric datasets to cover a much wider range of tasks, objects, and environments. However, obtaining reliable human action trajectories requires accurate camera-pose and hand-pose estimation, introducing additional processing cost and reducing label reliability ( Li et al., 2026b ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, videos without action labels still contain informative interaction dynamics that WAMs can exploit through world modeling ( Kareer et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026a ; DynaRobotics, 2026 ) . These factors are often entangled when egocentric data is summarized only by duration, making it difficult to determine whether downstream gains arise from stronger human-robot alignment, broader behavioral coverage, different training objectives, or increased data scale itself.
blocks.zh: 以电子为中心的数据在几个维度上有所不同,这些维度会直接影响其对机器人学习的效用. 在光谱的一端,人类的演示可以在视角,运动速度和行为风格上与机器人数据仔细地对接,可以促进交叉表现的学习,但限制了可以收集的经验的多样性. 放宽这些对齐限制,可以使以自我为中心的数据集涵盖范围更广的任务、对象和环境。 然而,获得可靠的人类动作轨迹需要精确的相机和手接相机估计,引入额外的处理成本并降低标签可靠性(Li等,2026b; 郑等,2026). 尽管如此,没有动作标签的视频仍然包含信息性互动动态,WAM可以通过世界建模加以利用(Kareer等,2025a; Li等, 2026a; DynaRobotics, 2026). 这些因素常常被缠绕在一起,因为只按持续时间来总结以自我为中心的数据,因此难以确定下游收益是来自更强大的人-机器人对接,更广泛的行为覆盖,不同的训练目标,还是数据规模的扩大本身.

blocks.en: To disentangle these factors, we conduct a systematic study of how to scale and use egocentric human data for robot learning under a unified WAM framework. We keep the model backbone fixed across our main experiments, while varying data alignment, coverage, supervision, and usage strategy. We first study human-robot alignment by examining whether aligned human demonstrations can improve out-of-distribution robot generalization and reduce the need for robot data. We then separate data duration from task diversity, comparing denser coverage of existing tasks with broader coverage across different behaviors. Finally, we relax action supervision and investigate whether large-scale egocentric videos without reliable action labels can still contribute through world modeling, and how such supervision interacts with subsequent video-action training. In this way, we disentangle data properties and usage strategies that aggregate scaling otherwise conflates.
blocks.zh: 为了解开这些因素,我们系统地研究如何在一个统一的WAM框架下,将以自我为中心的人类数据用于机器人学习. 我们在整个主要试验中保持模型主干线的固定,同时数据协调、覆盖、监督和使用战略各不相同。 我们首先研究人与机器人的对接,通过检查对接的人类演示是否能改善分流外机器人通化,并减少对机器人数据的需求. 然后,我们把数据持续时间与任务多样性分开,将现有任务的密集范围与不同行为的更广泛的范围进行比较。 最后,我们放松行动监督,并调查没有可靠行动标签的大规模自我中心视频是否仍然可以通过世界建模作出贡献,以及这种监督如何与随后的视频行动培训互动. 通过这种方式,我们分解了数据属性和使用策略,这些策略汇总了原本缩放的缩放.

blocks.en:
Crucially, we evaluate the utility of egocentric data by measuring its effect on closed-loop policy performance on both real-world and RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026 ) manipulation tasks, rather than relying on human-action prediction MSE alone. Across these studies, we find that egocentric data provides distinct benefits under different conditions. Human demonstrations covering object and scene conditions absent from robot training substantially improve OOD generalization and reduce the amount of target-task robot data required. Increasing data duration and task diversity leads to different performance trends across downstream capabilities. Video-only experience remains valuable beyond the subset with reliable action supervision, providing a strong foundation for subsequent video-action training. These findings show that the value of egocentric data depends not on scale alone, but on the distributions it covers, the supervision it reliably provides, and how it is used alongside robot data across the training pipeline.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh:
关键是,我们评价以自我为中心的数据的效用,方法是衡量其对闭路政策表现对现实世界和RoboDojo(Chen等,2026年)操纵任务的影响,而不是仅仅依靠人的行动预测MSE。 通过这些研究,我们发现,以自我为中心的数据在不同条件下提供了明显的好处。 涵盖机器人培训中缺失的物体和场景条件的人类示范大大改进了OOD通俗化,并减少了所需的目标任务机器人数据量. 数据持续时间和任务多样性的增加导致下游能力的绩效趋势不同。 仅录相经验在有可靠行动监督的子集之外仍然很宝贵,为随后的录相行动培训奠定了坚实的基础。 这些调查结果表明,以自我为中心的数据的价值不单单取决于规模,而是取决于它覆盖的分布,它可靠的监督,以及它如何与整个培训管道的机器人数据一起使用。
我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • We study the utility of egocentric human data for robot learning under a controlled WAM framework. With the WAM backbone fixed, we disentangle data properties and usage strategies that large-scale scaling studies often couple. • We characterize how human-robot alignment, data duration and task diversity, and available supervision affect downstream robot learning. This reveals distinct roles of these factors that are obscured when egocentric data is characterized only by its overall scale. • We evaluate these effects directly through closed-loop policy performance on real robots and simulation rather than relying on human-action prediction metrics alone. Our results provide practical guidance on what egocentric data to collect, what supervision to obtain, and how to use human data across robot learning.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们研究以自我为中心的人类数据在受控制的WAM框架下用于机器人学习的效用. 随着WAM主干线的固定,我们解开数据属性和使用策略,大规模缩放研究往往相互配合。 我们描述人类-机器人对接、数据期限和任务多样性以及可用的监督如何影响下游机器人学习。 这揭示出这些因素的独特作用,当以自我为中心的数据仅以其总体规模为特征时,这些因素就变得模糊不清。 我们直接通过对真正的机器人和模拟的闭路政策性能来评估这些效果,而不是仅仅依靠人类动作预测指标. 我们的成果为收集何种自负中心数据提供了实际指导,为获得何种监督,以及如何在机器人学习过程中使用人类数据提供了实际指导。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Egocentric Human Data. Egocentric human data has attracted increasing attention in robot learning because it can be collected at substantially lower cost than robot teleoperation while covering a much broader range of objects, scenes, tasks, and interaction patterns.
Large-scale datasets such as Ego4D ( Grauman et al., 2022 ) , Egocentric-10K ( BuildAI, 2025 ) , and RekaDaily-10K ( RekaAI, 2026 ) primarily capture first-person activities from everyday life and work, providing large-scale visual and behavioral experience.
More recent manipulation-oriented datasets, including EgoDex ( Hoque et al., 2026 ) , EgoLive ( Li et al., 2026c ) , and EgoSuite ( LightwheelAI, 2026 ) , further augment egocentric observations with structured hand pose annotations ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ) .
Such action annotations make human experience more directly usable for robot policy learning, but obtaining reliable action trajectories introduces additional sensing, reconstruction, and quality-control requirements, limiting the amount of data that can be annotated with high confidence.
A further step is to collect human demonstrations that are better aligned with downstream robot tasks. For example, EgoVerse ( Punamiya et al., 2026 ) considers task-aligned and environment-aligned human data for human-to-robot transfer. Although stronger alignment facilitates transfer to robot learning, it also imposes stricter collection requirements.
Consequently, modern egocentric data naturally spans a spectrum from large-scale video-only experience to action-annotated data and robot-aligned demonstrations, with different levels of alignment and supervision.
As illustrated in Figure 1 , we organize this spectrum as an egocentric data pyramid , retaining each sample at the most reliable supervision level it can support. This perspective provides a basis for studying which data properties deserve more attention, what supervision is worth obtaining, and how to use egocentric data as its scale continues to grow.
blocks.zh:
爱高中心人类数据. 以电子为中心的人类数据在机器人学习中吸引了越来越多的关注,因为它的收集成本可以大大低于机器人远程操作,同时涵盖范围更广的物体、场景、任务和互动模式。
Ego4D(Grauman等,2022年),Egocent-10K(BuildAI,2025年)等大型数据集,以及RekaDaily-10K(RekaAI,2026年)主要捕获日常生活和工作中的第一人称活动,提供大规模视觉和行为体验.
更近期的以操纵为导向的数据集,包括"EgoDex"(Hoque等,2026年),"EgoLive"(Li等,2026年c)和"EgoSuite"(LightwheelAI,2026年),以结构化的手作说明来进一步增强以自我为中心的观测(Pavlakos等,2024年).
这样的动作说明使得人类的经验更能直接地被机器人的政策学习所利用,但获得可靠的动作轨迹会引入额外的感知,重建和质量控制要求,限制了可以高度自信地被附加注释的数据数量.
下一步是收集更符合下游机器人任务的人类演示. 例如,EgoVerse(Punamiya等,2026年)考虑将任务相通和环境相通的人类数据用于人到机器人相通传输. 虽然更紧密的对接有利于向机器人学习的转移,但也规定了更严格的收集要求.
因此,现代以自我为中心的数据自然跨越从大规模仅录相经验到行动附加说明的数据和机器人相配合的演示,并有不同程度的校正和监督。
如图1所示,我们把这个频谱组织成一个以自我为中心的数据金字塔,将每个样本保留在它能够支持的最可靠的监督级别上。 这一视角为研究哪些数据属性值得更多关注,哪些监管值得获得,以及如何在数据规模不断扩大时使用以自我为中心的数据提供了依据.

blocks.en:
Utilizing Egocentric Data for Robot Learning. Recent work increasingly studies how egocentric human experience can support robot learning across different training settings. For task-aligned transfer, EgoVerse ( Punamiya et al., 2026 ) shows that broad human experience can be adapted effectively with a small amount of aligned human–robot data, while EgoWAM ( Li et al., 2026a ) investigates how different world-prediction objectives transfer human experience under controlled human–robot alignment.
At larger scale, Being-H0 ( Luo et al., 2025 ) and EgoScale ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) use retargeted human actions to pretrain transferable manipulation priors, while Being-H0.7 ( Team, 2026 ) and OpenWAM ( Wang et al., 2026c ) further introduce future or video prediction so that egocentric observations can contribute through world-model supervision. Complementary efforts reduce the embodiment gap by explicitly transforming human experience toward the robot domain through hand and wrist retargeting, action-space or viewpoint alignment, and visual embodiment editing ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Such conversion can make human data easier to incorporate into robot policies, but also introduces additional dependence on camera tracking, hand reconstruction, and visual synthesis, whose errors and embodiment ambiguities can limit reliability.
More recently, EgoScale ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , Motus2 ( Bi et al., 2026 ) , and Dyna-2 ( DynaRobotics, 2026 ) have demonstrated favorable scaling trends with increasingly large human-data mixtures. These results establish the scalability of human experience, but aggregate scaling curves and open-loop human prediction metrics do not fully reveal which properties of egocentric data drive downstream robot gains, or whether their relative benefits persist under closed-loop deployment. Rather than focusing on converting human data into robot-compatible supervision, we systematically study data properties and usage strategies under a controlled WAM framework. We evaluate these factors directly through closed-loop robot performance, aiming to provide actionable guidance on what egocentric data to collect, what supervision to retain, and how to use such data for robot learning.
blocks.zh:
利用爱果中心 机器人学习数据. 最近的工作越来越多地研究以自我为中心的人类经验如何能够支持机器人在不同培训环境中学习。 对于任务相适应的转移,EgoVerse(Punamiya等,2026年)表明,广泛的人类经验可以通过少量的对接人-机器人数据有效适应,而EgoWAM(Li等,2026年a)则调查不同的世界预测目标如何在受控的人类-机器人相匹配下转移人类经验.
在更大的规模上,Being-H0(Luo等,2025年)和Ego Scale(Zheng等,2026年)使用再定向的人类行动来预先训练可转移的操纵前作;而Being-H0.7(Team,2026年)和OpenWAM(Wang等,2026年c)则进一步引入了未来或视频预测,使以自负为中心的观测能够通过世界模型监督做出贡献. 补充努力通过手和手腕重定向、行动空间或视线对接以及视觉化的编辑,将人类经验明确转化为机器人领域,从而缩小了浮雕差距(Wang等,2026b)。 这种转换可以使人类数据更容易地纳入机器人政策,但也引入了对相机跟踪,手部重建,和视觉合成的额外依赖,其出错和浮雕模糊会限制可靠性.
最近,Ego Scale(郑等,2026年),Motus2 (Bi等人,2026年),和Dyna-2(DynaRobotics,2026年)都表现出了人类数据混合物日益庞大的有利缩放趋势. 这些结果确立了人类经验的可扩展性,但总缩放曲线和开阔的人类预测指标并不能充分揭示出以自负为中心的数据驱动下游机器人增益的特性,或者其相对收益是否在闭阔部署下持续存在. 我们不是注重将人类数据转换成机器人兼容的监管,而是在受控制的WAM框架下系统研究数据属性和使用策略. 我们直接通过闭路机器人的性能来评估这些因素, 目的是提供可操作的指导, 说明需要收集哪些自我中心数据, 需要保留哪些监督, 以及如何将这些数据用于机器人学习。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our goal is to provide a controlled framework for studying how egocentric data contributes to robot learning under different supervision and alignment settings. We therefore keep the model backbone and unified action space fixed across our main experiments, while varying the data composition, supervision, and usage strategies.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是提供一个控制框架,用于研究以自我为中心的数据如何有助于机器人在不同的监督和校正环境中学习。 因此,我们在整个主要实验中保持模型主干和统一行动空间的固定,同时改变数据组成、监督和使用战略。

blocks.en: 3.1 Egocentric Data Pyramid
blocks.zh: 3.1 爱神中心 数据金字塔

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 2 and illustrated in Figure 1 , egocentric data varies substantially in human-robot alignment and available supervision. We organize these differences into an egocentric human data pyramid, ranging from a small amount of robot-aligned human demonstrations to large-scale action-annotated data and a larger collection of video-only data.
blocks.zh: 如第2节所讨论和图1所说明的,在人与机器人对接和现有监督方面,自我中心数据差别很大。 我们把这些差异组织成一个以自我为中心的人类数据金字塔, 从少量的机器人对接的人类演示到大规模的行动附加数据 以及更大的只收集视频的数据。

blocks.en:
EgoAlign is our internally collected dataset, processed separately to form the robot-aligned subset with closely matched task and behavioral distributions. We obtain human actions through a hand-pose and camera-pose annotation pipeline, with implementation details in the appendix. For public datasets with available action annotations, we further apply temporal and geometric filters to control action quality, with the detailed filtering criteria described in the appendix. Samples that pass these filters form our quality-controlled multi-task video-action data.
We retain samples without action annotations, along with those rejected by the action-quality pipeline, as video-only data whenever the visual interaction remains valid. Although they do not provide reliable action supervision, they still capture object motion, interaction outcomes, and scene transitions that can support world modeling. Together, these data constitute the egocentric data collection from which we construct the training subsets used in our subsequent experiments.
blocks.zh:
EgoAlign是我们内部收集的数据集,单独处理,形成机器人相接子集,任务和行为分布紧密相匹配. 我们通过手提和相机备注管道获得人类行动,执行细节载于附录。 对于有可用动作说明的公共数据集,我们进一步应用时间和几何滤波器来控制动作质量,附录中描述详细的滤波标准. 通过这些过滤器的样本构成我们质量控制的多任务视频动作数据.
我们保留了没有行动说明的样本,以及那些被行动质量管道拒绝的样本,只要视觉互动仍然有效,就只作为视频数据。 虽然它们不提供可靠的动作监督,但仍能捕捉到能够支持世界建模的物体运动,交互结果,和场景过渡. 这些数据共同构成以自我为中心的数据收集,我们从中构建了我们在随后的实验中使用的培训子集。

blocks.en: 3.2 World-Action Model Framework
blocks.zh: 3.2 世界行动示范框架

blocks.en: Figure 2: Illustration of the world-action model framework and unified human-robot action space.
blocks.zh: 图 2:世界行动模式框架和统一人-机器人行动空间图示.

blocks.en: Building on Yuan et al. (2026) , we design the backbone used throughout our study, as illustrated in Figure 2 (a). The model consists of a video branch for world modeling and an action branch for action prediction. Language instructions are used as conditioning signals, while proprioceptive states are provided only to the action branch and are not injected into the world-modeling branch. The two branches interact through shared attention. We consider two shared-attention mechanisms in our study. In the base formulation, future action tokens attend only to the current visual context. In the joint formulation, they can additionally attend to predicted future visual representations, while future visual tokens remain independent of action tokens in both settings. This formulation naturally supports different supervision regimes. Video-action data can jointly supervise world and action prediction, while video-only data can independently supervise world modeling.
blocks.zh: 在袁等(2026年)的基础上,我们设计了整个研究过程中使用的骨干,如图2(a)所示。 该模型由世界建模的视频分支和动作预测的动作分支组成. 语言指令被作为条件信号使用,而自发状态则只提供给动作分支,而不会被注入到世界模型分支. 两个分支通过共同关注进行互动. 我们的研究考虑了两个共同关注机制。 在基础表述中,未来的动作符号只关注当前视觉背景. 在联合表述中,他们可以额外关注预测出的未来视觉表现,而未来的视觉标志仍然独立于两种场合下的行动标志. 这种提法自然支持不同的监督制度。 视频动作数据可以联合监督世界和动作预测,而视频专用数据可以独立监督世界建模.

blocks.en: 3.3 Unified Action Space
blocks.zh: 3.3 统一行动空间

blocks.en: Human and robot actions differ substantially in their embodiment-specific control dimensions. Rather than fully retargeting human motion to robot joint commands, we define a unified action space that explicitly separates robot-specific control from components shared across embodiments. As shown in Figure 2 (b), all tasks in our study use bimanual control. Each arm is represented by a 16D action vector consisting of a 6D joint signal, a 1D gripper state, and a 9D end-effector (EEF) representation, where the EEF component contains 3D translation and a 6D rotation representation. We concatenate the two arms’ actions into a 32D bimanual action space.
blocks.zh: 人的行动和机器人的行动在具体表现的控制方面差别很大。 我们不是将人类运动完全重新定位为机器人联合指令,而是定义一个统一的行动空间,明确区分机器人特定控制与各化身共享的组件. 如图2(b)所示,我们研究中的所有任务都采用双人控制. 每个臂由16D动作矢量代表,由6D联合信号,1D抓取器状态和9D终端效应器(EEF)代表组成,其中EEF组件包含3D翻译和6D旋转表示. 我们把两只武器的行动整合成32D双人行动空间。

blocks.en: For egocentric human data with action annotations, we supervise only the components that admit a meaningful cross-embodiment correspondence. Following prior human-robot co-training practice, we use only the EEF pose and gripper state as the default shared representation for human motion. To handle the missing dimensions in the flow-matching action space, we use the analytic forward-noise strategy used in Wang et al. (2026c) , and provide the detailed formulation in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 对于带有动作说明的以自我为中心的人类数据,我们只监督那些接受有意义的交叉表达通信的组件. 遵循之前的人-机器人共同训练的实践,我们只使用EEF的姿势和握手状态作为人类运动的默认共享代表. 为了处理相流相匹配动作空间中缺失的维度,我们采用王等(2026c)中使用的分析前噪策略,并在附录中提供详细的配方.

blocks.en: 3.4 Training Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训议定书

blocks.en: We organize training into three stages according to the supervision available in our egocentric data pyramid. We use pre-training , mid-training , and post-training to denote world-model pre-training on egocentric video data, joint world-action mid-training on action-annotated data, and downstream robot adaptation, respectively. During pre-training, we optimize only the world-modeling objective on egocentric video. Mid-training uses samples with reliable actions and jointly optimizes world and action prediction. Post-training adapts the model to downstream robot manipulation using embodiment-specific robot demonstrations, optionally together with robot-aligned human data. We keep the model architecture fixed across these stages unless otherwise specified. The appendix provides detailed data mixtures, optimization schedules, and implementation settings.
blocks.zh: 我们根据自我中心数据金字塔中的监督,将培训分为三个阶段。 我们使用预训、中训和后训分别表示世界模式的自我中心视频数据预训、行动附加数据联合世界行动中训和下游机器人适应。 在预训期间,我们只优化了以自我为中心的视频上的世界模范目标. 中训使用有可靠动作的样本并联合优化了世界和行动预测. 后训练则会利用特有化能机器人的演示来使模型适应下游机器人的操纵,可选择性地与机器人相通的人类数据结合. 除非另有说明,否则我们将固定这些阶段的模型结构。 附录提供了详细的数据混合物、优化时间表和执行设置。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Our experiments follow the egocentric data pyramid, progressively relaxing constraints on human-data scaling. We begin with robot-aligned demonstrations to study OOD generalization and robustness. We then move to large-scale multi-task video-action data to examine transferable manipulation priors and scaling along data duration and task diversity. Finally, we relax action supervision to investigate whether video-only experience can further benefit robot learning.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验遵循以自我为中心的数据金字塔, 逐渐放松了对人类数据规模的限制。 我们首先进行机器人结合的演示,研究OD通俗化和强健性. 然后,我们转向大规模多任务视频行动数据,以审查可转移的操纵前科,并根据数据持续时间和任务多样性进行分级。 最后,我们放松行动监督,以调查仅录相经验是否能使机器人学习进一步受益.

blocks.en: We evaluate the effect of egocentric data on downstream robot performance through closed-loop evaluation, rather than relying on human-action prediction MSE as an open-loop proxy. For real-world evaluation, we use a bimanual Piper robot with parallel grippers and collect robot demonstrations through teleoperation. The appendix provides detailed task definitions, data collection protocols, and ID and OOD evaluation settings. For broader evaluation, we follow the official RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026 ) protocol and report both progress score and success rate. Since our model does not explicitly target long-term memory or VLM-based open instruction following, we focus primarily on Generalization , Precision , and Long-Horizon , while reporting results across all benchmark categories for completeness.

blocks.en: 4.1 Robot-Aligned Human Demonstrations
blocks.zh: 4.1 机器人-和谐人类示威

blocks.en: We first study robot-aligned human demonstrations to examine two questions: whether they improve out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization and robustness to unseen object and scene variations, and whether they reduce the amount of target-task robot supervision required. In particular, we conduct real-robot experiments on Place into the Basket and Fold Cloth , representing rigid-object pick-and-place and deformable-object manipulation, respectively. For each task, we collect 300 in-domain (ID) robot demonstrations and a matched human set containing 300 ID, 100 object-OOD, and 100 scene-OOD demonstrations under the same task specification. The OOD conditions are absent from robot training and are covered only by the corresponding human demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 我们首先研究与机器人相配合的人类演示,以研究两个问题:它们是否改善了外分配(OOD)的通俗化和坚固度来达到看不见的物体和场景变化,以及它们是否减少了所需的目标任务机器人监督量. 特别是,我们在"入篮"(Place into the Basket)和"出花克特"(Fold Cloth)上进行真正的机器人实验,分别代表了刚性-物体取出和放置以及可变形-物体操纵. 每个任务,我们收集了300个内域(ID)机器人演示以及一组匹配的人类演示,其中包含300个ID,100个对象-OOD,以及100个场景-OOO演示,根据相同的任务规格. 机器人训练中不包含OD条件,仅包含相应的人类演示.

blocks.en: Generalizing to Environments Unseen in Robot Data. Figures 3 and 4 show that human demonstrations from object or scene conditions absent from robot training can substantially improve robot performance under the corresponding conditions. On Place into the Basket , the robot-only policy achieves 60% ID success but drops to 10% on object-OOD and 0% on scene-OOD. Introducing object-OOD human demonstrations raises object-OOD success to 60%, and introducing scene-OOD human demonstrations raises scene-OOD success to 20% with a substantially larger gain in task progress. These results show that the model can acquire task-relevant knowledge about new objects and environments directly from human demonstrations. This provides a practical way to extend a robot policy to new objects and scenes without requiring corresponding robot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 通用到环境 在机器人数据中未见. 图3和图4显示,在机器人培训中缺失的物体或场景条件下的人类演示可以在相应条件下大幅度地提高机器人的性能. 在"入篮"(Place into the Basket)上,"机器人"政策实现了60%的ID成功,但在Object-OOD上却下降到了10%,在现场-OOD上下降到了0%. 引入Object-OD人类演示将Object-OO成功率提升至60%,引入场景-Oble人类演示将Oble-OD成功率提升至20%,任务进度大幅提升. 这些结果表明,该模型可以直接从人类演示中获得与任务相关的新物体和环境知识. 这为将机器人政策推广到新的物体和场景提供了实用的方法,而不需要相应的机器人演示.

blocks.en: Reducing Dependence on Robot Data. We next examine whether aligned human demonstrations can reduce the amount of target-task robot data required for policy learning. We vary the number of robot demonstrations on Fold Cloth while keeping the same 500 human demonstrations fixed. Reducing robot data from 300 to 100 demonstrations causes a substantial performance drop, whereas adding human data recovers 80% ID, 60% object-OOD, and 80% scene-OOD success. However, when robot supervision is further reduced to only 20 demonstrations, the same human data is no longer sufficient to recover effective policy performance. These results show that aligned human demonstrations can substantially reduce the dependence on target-task robot data, but cannot fully replace embodiment-specific robot supervision.
blocks.zh: 减少对机器人数据的依赖。 我们接下来要研究的是,统一人类示范是否能够减少政策学习所需的目标任务机器人数据。 我们在Fold Cloth上改变机器人示威的次数,同时保持同样的500人示威的固定. 将机器人数据从300个演示减少到100个,导致性能大幅下降,而增加人类数据则恢复了80%的ID,60%的OOD,80%的场景-OOD成功. 然而,当机器人监督被进一步缩减到只有20个演示时,同样的人类数据已经不足以恢复有效的政策性能. 这些结果显示,对齐的人类演示可以大大减少对目标任务机器人数据的依赖,但不能完全取代特有化身机器人监督.

blocks.en: 4.2 Scaling Beyond Task-Specific Egocentric Data
blocks.zh: 4.2 超越特定任务范围扩展偏心数据

blocks.en:
Although robot-aligned human demonstrations can effectively help models adapt to specific distributions, their dependence on target-task collection limits scalability. We therefore move to large-scale multi-task egocentric data collected independently of downstream tasks and investigate whether this experience can establish transferable manipulation priors before downstream adaptation. We further study how scaling along two key dimensions, data duration and task diversity, affects downstream robot learning. We call this stage multi-task mid-training , where we optimize both video and action objectives.
In addition to egocentric human data, we include approximately 90 hours of real-robot data to provide embodiment-specific grounding in the robot action space. The robot data contains only two generic task families, pick-and-place and towel folding, and the corresponding tasks, objects, and scenes do not overlap with downstream evaluation.
blocks.zh:
虽然机器人相通的人类演示可以有效地帮助模型适应特定的分布,但它们对目标任务收集的依赖限制了可扩展性. 因此,我们转向独立于下游任务而收集的大规模多任务自我中心数据,并调查这种经验是否能够在下游适应之前确定可转移的操纵前科。 我们进一步研究如何按照数据持续时间和任务多样性这两个关键维度来扩大对下游机器人学习的影响。 我们称这个阶段为多任务中期训练,
除了以自负为中心的人类数据之外,我们还包括大约90小时的真机器人数据,以提供机器人行动空间中特有地平面的化身. 机器人数据仅包含两个通用任务家族,取出并放置和毛巾折叠,相应的任务,对象,场景与下游评价并不相重叠.

blocks.en: Further Reducing Dependence on Robot Data. As shown in Figure 4 , with only 20 target-task robot demonstrations, adding the full aligned human set alone fails to recover useful performance. In contrast, after multi-task mid-training, the model achieves 80% success on ID, 80% on object-OOD, and 60% on scene-OOD using the same 20 robot demonstrations and aligned human data. Importantly, the amount of target-task robot data and the aligned human data do not change between these settings. The improvement therefore reflects the transferable priors acquired during multi-task mid-training. This suggests that broad multi-task experience can make limited downstream data more effective, further reducing dependence on target-task robot data.
blocks.zh: 进一步减少对机器人数据的依赖。 如图4所示,只有20个目标任务机器人演示,仅加上完全对齐的人类集无法恢复有用的性能. 相形之下,经过多任务中期训练,该模型在ID上取得了80%的成功,在Object-OOD上取得了80%的成功,在现场-OOD上实现了60%的成功,使用相同的20个机器人演示和对齐的人类数据. 重要的是,目标任务机器人数据和对齐的人类数据的数量在这些设置之间没有变化。 因此,这一改进反映了在多任务中期培训期间获得的可转移的前科。 这表明广泛的多任务经验可以使有限的下游数据更加有效,进一步减少对目标任务机器人数据的依赖.

blocks.en: Figure 5: RoboDojo evaluation under data-duration and task-diversity scaling. We visualize a subset of tasks with non-zero success rate, while all aggregate results are computed over the full evaluation task set. We provide complete per-task results in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 图5:在数据期限和任务多样性方面对机器人道克的评价。 我们以非零成功率将一组任务想象出来,而所有总体结果则根据整套评价任务进行计算。 我们在附录中提供了完整的每个任务结果。

blocks.en: Scaling Data Duration and Task Diversity. We next study how to scale multi-task human data by decomposing data scale into two dimensions: the data duration within a fixed task set and the diversity of tasks covered. We construct two controlled scaling sequences from the semantic task categories of our egocentric data. For duration scaling , we fix the same 500 most frequent tasks and increase the total duration from 1K to 2K and 4K hours. For task scaling , we progressively expand from 500 to 1K, 2K, and 6K tasks toward the naturally occurring long tail, while keeping the average duration per task approximately constant, resulting in 1K, 2K, 4K, and 12K hours of data.
blocks.zh: 扩展数据期限和任务多样性。 接下来,我们研究如何通过将数据规模分解为两个层面来扩大人类的多任务数据:固定任务组内的数据持续时间和涵盖的任务的多样性。 我们从自我中心数据的语义任务类别中 构建出两个有控制的缩放序列 为了延长时间,我们确定同样的500个最经常的任务,并将总时间从1K增加到2K和4K小时。 就任务规模而言,我们逐渐将任务从500个扩大到1K、2K和6K,向自然产生的长尾翼发展,同时使每个任务的平均持续时间保持大约不变,从而产生1K、2K、4K和12K小时的数据。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 5 , the two scaling directions lead to different capability profiles. With a fixed task set, increasing duration from 1K to 4K hours improves Generalization from 5.0 to 7.8 and Long-Horizon from 12.0 to 16.2. Increasing task diversity from 500 to 6K tasks similarly improves Generalization from 5.0 to 7.0 and Long-Horizon from 12.0 to 16.2, but Precision decreases as we introduce increasingly long-tail tasks. At matched data volumes of 2K and 4K hours, denser coverage of the top 500 tasks also remains stronger on several aggregate metrics than broader task sets. The task-level results further reveal substantial positive and negative transfer.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,两个缩放方向导致不同的能力配置。 有了一套固定的任务,时间从1K小时增加到4K小时,一般化从5.0小时增加到7.8小时,而长视从12.0小时增加到16.2小时。 任务多样性从500个增加到6K个,同样改进了一般化,从5.0个增加到7.0个,从12.0个增加到16.2个,但随着我们引入越来越长的任务,精度下降。 在2K和4K小时的相匹配数据量中,在几个总体指标上,对500个最大任务的覆盖面仍然比更广泛的成套任务更密集。 任务层面的成果进一步显示,大量正负转移。

blocks.en: These results show that data duration and task diversity are distinct, capability-dependent scaling axes. More data within existing tasks and broader task coverage benefit different capabilities and can also introduce trade-offs. Consequently, neither total hours nor task count alone adequately characterizes useful egocentric-data scale. The results suggest ensuring sufficient coverage of common behaviors before expanding aggressively into increasingly sparse long-tail tasks.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,数据持续时间和任务多样性是不同的、取决于能力的缩放轴。 在现有任务和更广泛的任务覆盖范围内提供更多数据,有利于不同的能力,也可以带来取舍。 因此,无论是总时数还是任务数都不足以说明有用的自我中心数据尺度。 结果表明,确保充分涵盖共同行为,然后大力扩展至日益稀少的长尾任务。

blocks.en: 4.3 Relaxing Action Supervision with Large-Scale Human Video
blocks.zh: 4.3 以大型人文视频放松行动监督

blocks.en: As egocentric data scales, obtaining reliable action supervision becomes increasingly costly. Human action labels rely on accurate hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and temporal quality control, while reconstruction failures and noisy trajectories further reduce usable video-action data. In contrast, the corresponding videos can still preserve informative object motion, interaction outcomes, and physical state transitions. Since WAMs can learn such dynamics directly through video prediction, we investigate whether video-only supervision can improve downstream robot learning without requiring reliable action labels, and how its benefits interact with subsequent video-action mid-training.
blocks.zh: 作为以自我为中心的数据尺度,获得可靠的行动监督的费用越来越高。 人类动作标签依赖于准确的手部重建,相机跟踪,以及时间质量控制,而重建失败和吵闹的轨迹会进一步减少可使用的视频动作数据. 相形之下,相应的视频仍然可以保存信息性物体运动,互动结果,以及物理状态过渡. 由于WAMs可以直接通过视频预测来学习这样的动态,因此我们调查只用视频监督是否能够改善下游机器人的学习而不需要可靠的动作标签,以及它的好处如何与随后的视频动作中程训练相互作用.

blocks.en: We call this stage video pre-training , where we optimize only the video-prediction objective. The pre-training set contains the same 12K hours of action-valid egocentric videos used for mid-training, plus approximately 3K additional hours sampled from the video-only data, for a total of 15K hours. Mid-training subsequently uses the 12K-hour action-valid subset together with the multi-task robot data described in Section 4.2 , jointly optimizing video and action objectives. The two stages are not designed as a compute-matched comparison, since video-only data is naturally available at a larger scale than reliably action-annotated data. This scale difference is reflected in the egocentric data pyramid and motivates studying how the two supervision regimes can be used together.
blocks.zh: 我们称这个舞台视频预训, 预训集包含用于中训的相同12K小时的动作有效自负心视频,外加从仅录相数据中抽取的约3K额外小时,共计15K小时. 中期训练随后使用12K小时动作验证子集以及第4.2节所描述的多任务机器人数据,共同优化了视频和行动目标. 这两个阶段不是作为计算匹配的比较设计的,因为仅录相数据在规模上自然比可靠行动说明数据大。 这种尺度差异体现在以自我为中心的数据金字塔上,并激励人们研究两种监督制度如何一起使用.

blocks.en: Learning Dynamics Priors without Action Supervision. As shown in Table 1 , the model without human pre-training or mid-training achieves an average RoboDojo score of 6.39 with a 3.15% success rate. Video-only pre-training improves this to 14.13 / 9.45% despite using no human action supervision, showing that egocentric experience remains valuable even when reliable action labels are unavailable. WAMs can therefore extend the usable data beyond the subset that supports imitation learning.
blocks.zh: 学习动态前科而不进行行动监督。 如表1所显示,没有人类预训或中训的模型平均能以3.15%的成功率达到6.39分. 尽管没有使用人类行动监督,但仅录相的预训将这一比率提高到了14.13/9.45 %,这表明,即使没有可靠的行动标签,以自我为中心的经验仍然是宝贵的。 因此,WAM可以将可用数据扩展到支持模仿学习的子集之外.

blocks.en: Applying video-action mid-training after pre-training further improves performance from 14.13 / 9.45% to 15.04 / 10.78%. This relatively small gain suggests that the two stages capture partially overlapping information about manipulation dynamics. More importantly, the same mid-training without prior video pre-training reaches only 10.28 / 6.42%. The substantial gap between these two settings highlights the importance of first establishing a strong world-modeling branch for WAMs, so that subsequent action learning can build on informative visual dynamics. Egocentric video is particularly suitable for this role, as it can be scaled without action labels while retaining dynamics.
blocks.zh: 在预训后应用视频动作中培训,进一步提高了性能,从14.13/9.4%提高到15.04/10.78%. 这一相对较小的收益表明,这两个阶段获取了部分重叠的关于操纵动态的信息. 更重要的是,没有事先录像预训的同一期中培训只达到10.28%/6.42%。 这两个环境之间的巨大差距凸显出首先为WAM建立一个强大的世界模范分支的重要性,这样之后的行动学习才能建立在信息化的视觉动态的基础上. 爱高中心视频特别适合这个角色,因为它可以在保留动态的同时,在没有动作标签的情况下被缩放.

blocks.en: Leveraging Dynamics Priors for Joint World-Action Learning. The results above show that large-scale video pre-training provides a strong dynamics prior for the world-modeling branch. We next ask whether this improved world representation can be more effectively exploited during downstream action learning. We compare the base and joint shared-attention mechanisms introduced in Section 3.2 , where the joint formulation additionally allows action prediction to access predicted future visual representations. Starting from the same video-pretrained model, switching from base to joint substantially improves the average RoboDojo score from 14.13 to 20.29 and the success rate from 9.45% to 14.35%. This suggests that stronger dynamics priors make predicted future representations more informative for action generation, allowing joint world-action learning to better exploit the knowledge acquired from egocentric video.
blocks.zh: 为世界联合行动学习利用动态前科。 上述结果显示,大型视频预训为世界建模分会前提供强大的动力. 我们接着问,在下游行动学习过程中,能否更有效地利用这种世界代表性的提高。 我们比较了第3.2节中提出的基础和共同分担机制,其中联合表述还使行动预测能够获取预测的未来视觉表现。 从同一视频预选模式开始,从基站向联站的转换大大改善了RoboDojo的平均得分,从14.13分到20.29分,成功率从9.4%到14.35%. 这表明,更强大的动态前传使预测的未来表现更能为行动生成提供信息,使联合世界行动学习能够更好地利用从以自我为中心的视频中获得的知识。

blocks.en: Interestingly, FastWAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) reports only small differences between its base and joint variants without embodied pre-training. Our results suggest a complementary explanation that the benefit of joint future conditioning depends on the quality of the learned world representation. With large-scale egocentric video pre-training, the same basic WAM backbone achieves an average RoboDojo score of 20.29 and a 14.35% success rate using only approximately 0.1K hours of multi-task robot data and 15K hours of egocentric experience. This result further demonstrates the potential of egocentric data to strengthen world dynamics in WAMs and highlights the importance of studying not only how much human data is available, but also how it is used throughout the training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,FastWAM(Yuan等,2026年)只报告其基础和联合变体之间的小差异而未包含预训. 我们的结果表明,一个补充解释,即联合未来条件的好处取决于世界知识代表的质量。 通过大规模自负式视频预训,同为基础的WAM主干线仅使用约0.1K小时的多任务机器人数据和15K小时自负式体验,实现了平均RoboDojo得分20.29分和14.35%的成功率. 这一结果进一步表明,以自我为中心的数据有可能加强WAMs中的世界动态,并突出表明,不仅必须研究现有多少人类数据,而且必须研究在整个培训过程中如何使用这些数据。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented a systematic study on scaling egocentric human data for robot learning with WAM. Rather than treating the duration of human data as a single measure of scale, we disentangled the roles of human-robot alignment, data duration and task diversity, available supervision, and usage strategies. The study leads to several key takeaways for scaling egocentric human data:
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了一个系统的研究, 以自我为中心的人类数据 用于机器人学习WAM。 我们不是将人类数据的持续时间作为一个尺度的单一衡量标准来看待,而是将人与机器人对接、数据持续时间和任务多样性、现有监督和使用战略的作用分开。 这项研究导致几项主要外卖,用于放大以自我为中心的人类数据:

blocks.en: • Human data reduces the need for robot data, but cannot fully replace it. Broad multi-task human experience provides transferable manipulation priors, aligned human demonstrations cover distribution variations, and a small amount of robot data remains important for embodiment adaptation. Their combination can substantially reduce the amount of target-task robot data. • Scaling egocentric data does not always lead to better performance. Data duration and task diversity represent different ways to scale, and total hours alone cannot characterize useful data scale. Denser coverage of recurring tasks provides limited additional gains, while introducing increasingly sparse long-tail tasks can even hurt precision-sensitive performance. • Egocentric data provides a strong dynamics prior for world-action learning. Video-only pre-training can learn strong dynamics priors without action labels, extending usable data beyond the action subset. Such priors further improve subsequent world-action learning, showing that the value of human data depends not only on its supervision, but also on when and how it is used.
blocks.zh: • 人类数据减少对机器人数据的需要,但不能完全取而代之。 广泛的多任务人类经验提供了可被转移的操纵前科,对齐的人类演示覆盖分布变异,少量的机器人数据仍然对活化改造很重要. 它们的组合可以大大减少目标任务机器人数据的数量. • 扩大以自我为中心的数据并不总是能带来更好的业绩。 数据持续时间和任务多样性代表着不同的尺度方法,单是总时数不能成为有用的数据尺度的特点. 重复任务覆盖的密度有限,额外收益有限,同时引进越来越稀少的长尾任务甚至会损害精准敏感的性能. • 以电子为中心的数据为世界行动学习提供了强大的动力。 仅录相的预训可以在没有动作标签的情况下学习强力动态前缀,将可用数据扩展到动作子集之外. 这种前科进一步改善了后来的世界行动学习,表明人类数据的价值不仅取决于其监督,也取决于其何时和如何使用.

blocks.en: A.1 Egocentric Data Pyramid
blocks.zh: A.1 以爱果为中心 数据金字塔

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the supervision hierarchy and available scale of the egocentric data considered in our study. The pyramid characterizes a general property of egocentric data rather than the exact data mixture used in each experiment. As stronger supervision is required, fewer samples can reliably satisfy the corresponding annotation and alignment requirements. Robot-aligned demonstrations therefore occupy the smallest tier, followed by multi-task video-action data with reliable human actions, while video-only data can be retained at substantially larger scale.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了我们的研究中考虑的自我中心数据的监督等级和现有规模。 该金字塔特征是自我中心数据的一般属性,而不是每个实验中使用的确切数据混合物. 由于需要加强监督,因此较少的样本能够可靠地满足相应的注释和校正要求. 因此,机器人相通的演示占据了最小的层级,其次是具有可靠人类行动的多任务视频动作数据,而仅视频数据则可以保留到大得多的规模.

blocks.en: We construct the pyramid based on the most reliable supervision each sample supports. We process EgoAlign separately as the robot-aligned subset. For public datasets with available hand or action annotations, we apply temporal and geometric quality-control filters to remove unreliable trajectories. Samples that pass the action-quality checks form the multi-task video-action data. Samples without reliable action annotations, including those rejected by the action-quality pipeline, can still be retained as video-only data when the underlying visual interaction remains valid. This way, unreliable action labels do not require discarding otherwise useful interaction videos.
blocks.zh: 我们建造金字塔 以每个样本支持的最可靠的监督为基础 我们分别以机器人组合子集处理 EgoAlign 。 对于有可用手或动作说明的公共数据集,我们采用时间和几何质量控制过滤来去除不可靠的轨迹. 通过动作质量检查的样本构成多任务视频动作数据. 没有可靠行动说明的样本,包括那些被行动质量管道所拒绝的样本,在基本的视觉互动仍然有效时仍可保留为仅作为视频的数据. 这样,不可靠的动作标签不需要丢弃原本有用的交互视频.

blocks.en: Importantly, the approximately 120K hours of video-only data shown in Figure 1 represent the available data scale and are not all used in our experiments. Due to practical training constraints, we construct task-specific training subsets from this collection. In our main video pre-training experiments, we use the 12K-hour action-valid subset with video supervision only, plus about 3K additional hours sampled from the video-only data, for a total of 15K hours of egocentric video. We then use the 12K-hour action-valid subset for multi-task mid-training with both video and action supervision. Thus, the pyramid primarily shows how the amount of usable egocentric experience increases as supervision requirements are relaxed, while the corresponding experiments specify the exact data mixtures used at each training stage.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,图1所示的大约120K小时的视频数据代表了现有数据尺度,并非全部用于我们的实验。 由于实际培训方面的限制,我们从本汇编中构建了具体任务的培训子集。 在我们主要的视频前训练实验中,我们使用12K小时动作验证子集,只进行视频监督,再加上从视频唯一数据中抽取的约3K额外小时,总共15K小时自负式视频. 然后,我们使用12K小时行动有效子集进行多任务中期培训,同时进行视频和行动监督。 因此,金字塔主要显示随着监督要求的放松,可用自我中心经验的数量如何增加,而相应的实验则具体说明了在每个培训阶段使用的确切数据混合物。

blocks.en: A.2 EgoAlign
blocks.zh: A.2 电子对齐

blocks.en: EgoAlign is our internally collected egocentric dataset for studying robot-aligned human demonstrations. We record human demonstrations using a monocular head-mounted camera under task and environment settings matching the real-robot experiments. All participants provided informed consent for data collection and research use. We recover human hand actions from the recorded videos, referring to the general processing pipeline of OpenAoE ( Li et al., 2026d ) .
blocks.zh: EgoAlign是我们内部收集的以自我为中心的数据集,用于研究机器人相适应的人类演示. 我们在任务和环境设置下 使用单相机记录人类的演示 与真正的机器人实验相匹配 所有与会者都对数据收集和研究使用提供了知情同意。 提到OpenAoE(Li等,2026d.)的一般处理管道。

blocks.en:
Specifically, we first estimate the camera trajectory using VGGT-Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and take the coordinate system of the first camera frame as the reference frame for each sequence. We then use GroundingDINO ( Liu et al., 2024 ) to localize hand regions and apply HaMeR ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ) to estimate the 3D hand poses independently for each frame. Combining the estimated hand pose with the recovered camera trajectory transforms the frame-wise hand predictions into a temporally shared coordinate system referenced to the first camera frame. The resulting trajectories provide the hand motion used to construct the shared end-effector and gripper supervision for human demonstrations.
Finally, we inspect and filter the reconstructed trajectories to remove samples with unreliable hand localization, implausible hand motion, unstable camera tracking, or obvious temporal and geometric inconsistencies. We retain only sequences that pass this quality-control process as action-annotated EgoAlign demonstrations.
blocks.zh:
具体来说,我们首先使用VGGT-Omega(Wang等,2026a)来估计相机轨迹,并取第一相机帧的坐标系统作为每个相机序列的参考框架. 然后,我们使用地平地DINO(Liu等,2024年)将手区域本地化,并应用HaMeR(Pavlakos等,2024年)对每个相框独立地估计出三维手所构成. 将估计的手姿与回收相机轨迹相结合,将帧相机手势预测转换成一个时间共享的坐标系统,参照第一个相机相机相机相机. 由此产生的轨迹提供了用于构建人类示威共用的末端效应器和抓取器监督器的手动.
最后,我们检查和过滤重建的轨迹,以取出不可靠的手部定位,不可信的手动,不稳定的相机跟踪,或明显的时间和几何不一致的样本. 我们只保留通过质量控制过程的序列,作为附加说明的EgoAlign演示。

blocks.en: Our implementation is built upon the StarVLA codebase ( Community, 2026 ) , with modifications to support our WAM architecture, unified human-robot action space, and multi-stage training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们的实施建立在StarVLA codebase(社区,2026年)之上,并进行了修改,以支持我们的WAM架构,统一的人-机器人行动空间,以及多阶段培训管道.

blocks.en: We use five training configurations across our experiments: video pre-training, full-scale multi-task mid-training, scaling-study mid-training, real-robot post-training, and RoboDojo post-training. Table 3 summarizes the detailed optimization settings. Unless otherwise specified, all experiments use a per-GPU batch size of 16 with 8 NVIDIA H20 GPUs per node, cosine learning-rate decay, 8-frame future video prediction, and a 32-step action prediction horizon.
blocks.zh: 我们在整个实验中使用了5个训练配置:视频预训,全程多任务中训,规模化学习中训,实相机器人后训,和RoboDojo后训. 表3概述了详细的优化设置。 除非另有说明,所有实验都使用每个节点有8个NVIDIA H20 GPU的每GPU批量尺寸为16个,同位素学习-速率衰变,8帧未来视频预测,以及32步动作预测视野.

blocks.en: For the scaling study, all data-duration and task-diversity variants use the same training configuration and number of optimization steps; only the scale and composition of the egocentric training data are changed. Similarly, all real-robot tasks and robot-data-budget ablations share the same post-training recipe, and all RoboDojo experiments use the same RoboDojo post-training configuration.

blocks.en: C.1 Real-Robot Setup
blocks.zh: C.1 实际机器人设置

blocks.en: Robot Platform and Data Collection. We conduct real-world experiments using a bimanual Piper robot equipped with parallel grippers. Robot demonstrations are collected through teleoperation. We record human demonstrations in EgoAlign separately using a monocular head-mounted camera under the corresponding task and environment settings, then convert them into the shared gripper action representation described in Section B.1 . Human and robot demonstrations therefore share the same task specification and environment conditions, while retaining their native viewpoints and embodiments.
blocks.zh: 机器人平台与数据收集. 我们用一个双人管道机器人进行真实世界的实验 配备平行的抓手 机器人演示是通过远程操作收集的。 我们在EgoAlign中单独记录人类在相应任务和环境设置下使用单相机头挂相机的演示,然后将其转换为B.1节所描述的共享抓取动作表示. 因此,人类和机器人的演示具有相同的任务规格和环境条件,同时保留其本土观点和表现。

blocks.en: Evaluation Tasks. Our controlled real-robot experiments focus on two representative manipulation tasks, Place into the Basket and Fold Cloth , covering rigid-object pick-and-place and deformable-object manipulation, respectively. For each task, we collect 300 in-domain (ID) robot demonstrations. The corresponding EgoAlign set contains 300 ID, 100 object-OOD, and 100 scene-OOD human demonstrations. The object- and scene-OOD conditions are absent from robot training unless otherwise specified, allowing us to evaluate whether human demonstrations can provide information about environment variations not covered by robot data.
blocks.zh: 评价任务。 我们控制的真机器人实验集中于两个具有代表性的操纵任务,即"放入篮子"和"花式克洛斯"(Fold Cloth),分别涵盖刚性物体取出和放置和可变形物体的操纵. 每个任务,我们收集300个内域(ID)机器人演示. 相应的EgoAlign集包含300个ID,100个对象-OOD,以及100个场景-OOD人类演示. 除非另有说明,否则机器人培训中缺少物体和场景OOD条件,使我们能够评估人类演示是否能够提供关于机器人数据未涵盖的环境变化的信息。

blocks.en: Object-OOD evaluation varies the manipulated objects beyond those appearing in the ID robot demonstrations, including changes in object category, instance, appearance, or size. Scene-OOD evaluation changes the surrounding visual environment, including tabletop or tablecloth appearance and illumination conditions. These two axes capture complementary forms of distribution shift and need not be strictly mutually exclusive.
blocks.zh: Object-OOD评价除了ID机器人演示中出现的被被操纵的物体之外,还不同,包括对象类别,实例,外观或大小的变化. 场景-OOD评价改变周围的视觉环境,包括平面或平面布外观和照明条件. 这两条轴线捕捉了互补形式的分配转移,不需要严格地相互排斥.

blocks.en: In addition to these controlled experiments, we evaluate the final model on a broader set of four real-world manipulation tasks: Fold Towel , Tighten a Bottle Cap , Stack Plates and Bowls , and Heat Food with a Microwave . These tasks span rigid-object manipulation, deformable-object interaction, and longer-horizon manipulation.
blocks.zh: 除了这些有控制的实验外,我们评价最终模型,涉及更广泛的四个现实世界操纵任务: 软毛巾 收紧瓶盖 堆积板和碗 和加微波热食品 这些任务跨越了刚性-对象操纵,可变形-对象相互作用,以及更远的视野操纵.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate all policies through closed-loop execution and report both task success rate and normalized task progress. Success rate is a binary metric that records whether the complete task is successfully accomplished within a rollout. Normalized task progress provides a finer-grained measure of partial task completion on a scale from 0 to 100. We define task-specific intermediate milestones according to the natural execution stages of each task and apply the same scoring criteria to all compared methods and evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 评价计量。 我们通过闭关执行评估所有政策,并报告任务成功率和正常任务进展情况。 成功率是一个二进制的衡量标准,它记录整个任务在推出过程中是否成功完成. 正规化任务进度为部分任务完成量提供了更精细的尺度,从0到100。 我们根据每项任务的自然执行阶段确定具体任务的中间里程碑,并对所有比较的方法和评价设置适用同样的评分标准。

blocks.en: For Place into the Basket , each rollout contains three target objects. Successfully placing each object into the basket contributes 25 points. If all three objects are successfully grasped on their first grasp attempt, an additional 25 points are awarded. A rollout is considered successful when all three objects are placed into the basket.
blocks.zh: 对于"入篮",每次推出包含三个目标对象. 成功将每个对象放入篮子,贡献了25分. 如果所有三个物体都成功把握了它们的第一次抓取尝试,则额外判给25分. 当三个物体都放入篮子时,推出被认为是成功的.

blocks.en: For Fold Cloth , the task is divided into four stages: completing the first fold, pulling the cloth into the required configuration, completing the second fold, and completing the third fold. Each completed stage contributes 20 points. If all four stages are completed successfully in a single execution without retries, an additional 20 points are awarded. A rollout is considered successful when the complete folding procedure is finished.
blocks.zh: 对于Fold Cloth ,任务分为四个阶段:完成第一个折叠,将布拉入需要的配置,完成第二个折叠,完成第三个折叠. 每个完成的阶段贡献了20分. 如果所有四个阶段在一次执行中都顺利完成而无需复试,则再授予20分. 当完整的折叠程序完成时,推出被认为是成功的.

blocks.en: C.2 RoboDojo Setup
blocks.zh: C.2 机器人 道场设置

blocks.en: We use RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026 ) as a standardized closed-loop benchmark for evaluating manipulation policies across a broad range of tasks. We follow the official RoboDojo post-training and evaluation protocol and report both progress score and success rate. All RoboDojo experiments use the same post-training configuration described in Section B.3 , allowing comparison of models with different egocentric pre-training and mid-training strategies under a consistent downstream setting.
blocks.zh: 我们使用RoboDojo(Chen等,2026年)作为标准封闭式落地基准,用于评估涉及广泛任务的操纵政策。 我们遵循RoboDojo官方的培训和评估后规程,报告进度得分和成功率。 所有RoboDojo实验都采用B.3节所描述的相同的后训练配置,可以在一致的下游环境下,将模型与不同的以自负为中心的前训练和中训练策略进行比较.

blocks.en: RoboDojo organizes its evaluation tasks into five categories: Generalization , Precision , Long-Horizon , Memory , and Open . We report results on all five categories as well as the official average over the complete evaluation suite. Since our model does not explicitly introduce a long-term memory mechanism or a VLM-based module for open-ended instruction following, our analysis in the main paper focuses primarily on Generalization , Precision , and Long-Horizon , while Memory and Open are retained for completeness.
blocks.zh: RoboDojo将其评价任务分为五个类别:通用、精密、长视、记忆和开放。 我们报告所有五个类别的结果以及整个评价套间的官方平均数。 由于我们的模型没有明确引入一个长期的内存机制或一个基于VLM的模块,在接下来的开放式指令中,我们在主要论文中的分析主要集中于通论(Generalization),精度(Precision)和长视野(Long-Horizon),而记忆和开放则保留完整.

blocks.en: For the data-scaling study, we compute all reported category averages over the complete RoboDojo evaluation task set. For readability, the task-level visualization in the main paper shows only tasks on which at least one evaluated setting achieves successful rollouts. The complete per-task results, including tasks with zero success across the compared settings, are provided in Figure 7 .
blocks.zh: 就数据测距研究而言,我们计算了整个RoboDojo评价任务组上所有报告的类别平均值。 关于可读性,主要论文中的任务级可视化只显示至少有一项评价设定能成功展开的任务. 图7提供了每项任务的全部结果,包括比较情况下没有成功的任务。

blocks.en: C.3 Data Duration and Task-Diversity Scaling
blocks.zh: C.3 数据期限和任务多样性的扩大

blocks.en: We construct the scaling subsets according to semantic task categories in the egocentric data. The task distribution is naturally imbalanced: a relatively small number of common manipulation behaviors account for a large fraction of the available data, while many less frequent tasks contain substantially fewer demonstrations. We refer to this less frequent portion of the empirical task distribution as the long tail .
blocks.zh: 我们在自我中心数据中按照语义任务类别构建缩放子集. 任务分布自然是不平衡的:相对较少的常见操纵行为占了可用数据的一大部分,而许多不太频繁的任务包含的演示数量则要少得多. 我们把经验性任务分配中不太频繁的部分称为长尾巴。

blocks.en: For duration scaling, we fix the 500 most frequent tasks and progressively increase the amount of data sampled from this fixed task set from 1K to 2K and 4K hours. This increases experience density within a common set of behaviors without expanding task coverage. For task-diversity scaling, we progressively expand the task set from the most frequent categories toward less frequent ones, using 500, 1K, 2K, and 6K tasks. We approximately preserve the average amount of data per task, resulting in 1K, 2K, 4K, and 12K hours of training data, respectively. As the task set grows, we introduce increasingly rare categories from the tail of the empirical task distribution into training.
blocks.zh: 在延长期限方面,我们确定500个最经常的任务,并逐步增加从这一固定任务组抽取的数据数量,从1K到2K和4K小时。 这在不扩大任务覆盖范围的情况下,在一组共同的行为中提高了经验密度. 为了扩大任务的多样性,我们逐步扩大任务范围,从最经常的类别扩大到较少的类别,使用500个、1K个、2K个和6K个任务。 我们大约保留了每项任务的平均数据量,结果,培训数据分别为1K、2K、4K和12K小时。 随着任务数量的增加,我们从经验任务分配的尾部引入了越来越罕见的类别来进行培训。

blocks.en: All variants use the same model initialization, robot-data component, optimization schedule, and RoboDojo post-training protocol. The two scaling sequences therefore emphasize two different ways of increasing egocentric data scale: denser coverage of recurring behaviors and broader task coverage extending toward the long tail.
blocks.zh: 所有变体都使用相同的模型初始化,机器人数据组件,优化时间表,以及RoboDojo后训练协议. 因此,两个缩放序列强调两种增加自负中心数据尺度的不同方式:更密集地覆盖反复出现的行为,以及扩大任务范围以延伸至长尾.
